name: Test-Rite International Co., Ltd.
summary: Test-Rite International Co., Ltd. imports and exports hand tools, auto parts, machinery, furniture, and other home appliances in the United States of America, Canada, Great Britain, France, Germany, and Australia. It also operates retail chain stores and sells home-related products. The company engages in real estate development and planning business. In addition, it is involved in mechanical and electrical related construction activities. Further, the company engages in logistics warehousing related business. Test-Rite International Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.
